title: Studying at ETH Zurich is challenging, and all students have their own personal hurdles to overcome. This short video series gives a somewhat different insight into everyday life as a student. It provides an account of students, their setbacks and how they dealt with them.
main_content:
Main article: Studying at ETH Zurich is challenging, and all students have their own personal hurdles to overcome. This short video series gives a somewhat different insight into everyday life as a student. It provides an account of students, their setbacks and how they dealt with them.

Advice for students: ETH Zurich offers advice centres for (virtually) any situation that may arise during your studies.

Further information: Thanks to the ESOP scholarship , Agon Besimi was able to come to ETH Zurich.
